summary.en-US: Let Claude read the Firefox tabs you choose: page HTML, screenshots, console logs and network requests. You share each tab yourself, it's read-only, and nothing leaves your machine.

version.approval_notes: Sharepane connects to a local helper over native messaging (host name "sharepane"); it makes no network requests of its own. The helper is the open-source npm package "sharepane" from the same repository (packages/daemon). To test: install Node.js 18+, run `npx sharepane setup`, reload the extension, open any page, click the toolbar icon and turn on Share with Claude. `npx sharepane doctor` then reports "Firefox connection: Connected, 1 allowed tab". The extension's code is not minified or bundled. Optional <all_urls> is requested only when the user shares a site or turns on screenshots (tabs.captureTab needs it).
